svg.font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The modules. The desktop app starts the panel's server, which serves the page and Offerowl's one HTTP API; the page only calls the API, and the agent's tools (apps/mcp) call it too. The API and the offerowl command call the engine in src: ingest reads files into fact candidates; the writing modules call the one AI backend through llm.py; the renderers typeset the resume, the deck and the cover letter; the checks hold every sentence and page to its evidence and layout; the interview package builds the kit and the talk; decide answers typed questions. core/schema describes the files they share
